track_downtown_d: Downtown blocks, tight corners and neon on every wall.
track_harbor_d: A long quay by the water, container stacks and a hairpin.
track_express_d: Fast sweeping bends, a raised highway and a long tunnel.
hint_menu: A  Select    B  Back    Left / Right  Change
help_1: ZR or W: accelerate. ZL or S: brake, and reverse when stopped.
help_2: Left stick or A / D: steer.
help_3: Hold R or B (Space) while turning to drift. Drifting fills the nitro bar; let go after a long drift for a short boost.
help_4: A or E: nitro. It burns while held and gives the most on straights.
help_5: Y or C: change the camera. + or Esc: pause.
help_6: Touch: hold the left or right side of the screen to steer. The car accelerates by itself; the buttons brake, drift and fire the nitro.
help_7: Pass the checkpoints in order: cutting back across the line does not count a lap.
help_8: Your best lap and best race on every circuit are saved.
